verdict.rationale: Stripe documents verifying government-issued ID documents from more than 120 countries, and a customer notes you can specify which document types are accepted. However, the pack never enumerates passports, national IDs, driver licenses or residence permits, and never shows a published per-country support list. Community reports also point to coverage gaps: Polish IDs unsupported and Chinese/Asia-Pacific passports rejected as invalid. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported document types, a published per-country support list, and independent confirmation of breadth without notable regional gaps.
